verdict.rationale: Reflect is architected as a cloud-synced, end-to-end encrypted note app (sync across devices, E2E encryption) rather than local files or a local-first store the user can read without the app; the only ownership guarantee is export to Markdown/HTML, not native local storage, and offline support is only glancingly mentioned ('online or offline') without detail on full offline functionality. missing for 10: evidence of notes stored as local files/local-first DB, evidence of full offline parity, and confirmation the app doesn't require the cloud account for normal operation.
